sentences.japanese: 彼は弁護士にその書類を託すことにした。
sentences.english: He decided to trust the lawyer with the document.

sentences.japanese: 私は船長に命を託さなければならなかった。
sentences.english: I had to trust the captain with my life.

sentences.japanese: チーム再建を託された監督が脱税でクビだってよ。
sentences.english: I heard that the manager entrusted with rebuilding the team was fired for tax evasion.
